title: Highlight-to-Note Conversion Rate
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=highlight:capture
| stats count as highlights, sum(eval(if(converted_to_note="yes",1,0))) as converted by source
| eval conversion_pct=round(100*converted/highlights,1)
| sort - conversion_pct
description: Measures how often captured highlights turn into permanent notes instead of sitting unused.
value: Highlights are only valuable if they become working knowledge; conversion rate tells you whether your capture habit has downstream value.
implementation: Mark whether highlights become notes and calculate conversion percentage by capture source.
visualization: Table of sources with highlight conversion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how many of the passages you save actually turn into useful notes in your second brain.
